title.en: An Act Renaming Florida Elementary School Situated in Barangay Florida, Butuan City, into Mariana L. Pineda Memorial Elementary School

text.en: Renaming of School. - Florida Elementary School, a public elementary school situated in Barangay Florida, Butuan City, is hereby renamed and henceforth shall be known as Mariana L. Pineda Memorial Elementary School.

Repealing Clause. - All laws, decrees, executive orders and other administrative issuances and parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provision of this Act are hereby modified or superseded accordingly.
Separability Clause. - If any clause, provision, paragraph or part hereof shall he declared unconstitutional or invalid, it shall not affect the remaining provisions of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect upon its approva1.
